name: plan-kid
_: 55 screens and no app yet. Its own config already said the app's theme
'must be generated from these values, not re-picked by eye' — scaffolding
it from this file is what makes that sentence true rather than hopeful.
Renames applied: teal-* -> brand-*, coral-* -> accent-*.
`teal` was not only a hue name, it was a live bug: it shadowed Tailwind's
own built-in teal scale while declaring only 6 of 10 stops, so
teal-300/400/600/800 silently resolved to stock Tailwind teal wherever
they were used. Renaming to brand-* removes the collision outright.
A scope is a token remap, same as a theme — the mechanism from rule 07.
`sensitive` desaturates the accent and the danger colour for the loss
and grief screens. A utility written against a variable follows whichever
scope it lands in, so no markup changes.

reserved._: Five life stages. They tint whole screens, so they must not collide with a status colour.
